'''Version 1.9.19''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on May 13th 2024.  It was 25.75 MB.

== ''Change Log'' ==

====<u>Fixes</u>====
*Major Fix: Beckons sometimes reseting evolution phases
*Fixed Beckons spinning when spawning
*Sometimes console spam when spawning entities
*Devolution want killing all parasites, now if the parasites has a previously version it will spawn it
*Fix Stage IV Beckon still suffocating in ceilings
*Fix lures reporting wrong cooldown times
*Fix host using underground sounds when not underground
*Scents will now be deleted if the phase is below OneMind/Collective Consciousness phase (See new "CC Phase Locked" configuration option below to disable this fix)
*"Evolution Parasite Lock List" option not working
*Scents will now avoid being next to each other ("Scents now observe social distancing" -Modrome)
*Beckons will no longer spawn from residue until RS chance is above 0
*Parasites with a Scent Death Value below 3 should no longer create a scent
*By default, this should include all Ancient-tiers, Rupters, Buglins, etc.
*Adapted Arachnida step sounds not working
*Dispatcher crashes
===<u>Configuration</u>===
*"Phase Beckon Summoning Cooldown" option will be disabled for now
*"Evolution Parasite Lock List" added "0;4;92"
*"Evolution Parasite Lock List" added missing ids
*"Mobs with new griefing task" added "srparasites:hi_golem;3;40;2"
*Added Category for Evolution Phase 9
*Added Category for Evolution Phase 10
*New options:
**"Needler Maximum Damage Player" - "Maximum damage this effect will inflict to the player." - SRPConfigSystems.cfg
**"Needler Maximum Damage Monster" - "Maximum damage this effect will inflict to the Monster." - SRPConfigSystems.cfg
**"Evolution No Players Gaining" - "True if parasites can gain points when there are no players in the server." - SRPConfigSystems.cfg
**"Living Weapons HP Evolve" - "Value needed in order for Living weapons to evolve into Sentient Weapons." - SRPConfig.cfg
**"Phase Parasites Always Variant" - "From this phase on, Parasites will always spawn as a variant if available." - SRPConfigSystems.cfg
**"Phase Healing Affected" - "From this phase on, Healing is affected to non-parasites mobs." - SRPConfigSystems.cfg
**"Phase Healing Affected Value" - "Value of the healing ." - SRPConfigSystems.cfg
**"Phase Parasites Without XP" - "From this phase on, Parasites will no longer drop xp." - SRPConfigSystems.cfg
**"Phase Parasites Stats Increase" - "From this phase on, Parasites will spawn with an increase of stats." - SRPConfigSystems.cfg
**"Phase Parasites Stats Increase Value" - "Value." - SRPConfigSystems.cfg
**"Phase Spawning Denied" - "From this phase on, only Parasites will spawn naturally." - SRPConfigSystems.cfg
**"CC Phase Locked" - "Set to false for scents to be deleted if the phase is below CC required phase." - SRPConfigSystems.cfg
**"Evolution Parasite Lock Message" - "Message sent to all players when a parasite is unlocked" - SRPConfigSystems.cfg
**"Minimum Space Between Scents": Minimum distance the scent has to be from other scents. If a scent is within this distance from another scent, the newly-created (or loaded) scent will be deleted. - SRParasitesSystems.cfg
**"Scent Spawn Death Parasite Chance" - Chance to spawn a Scent when a parasite is killed." - SRParasitesSystems.cfg
**"Scent Player" - "Set to true if you want Scent to be activated only by Players" - SRParasitesSystems.cfg
*Removed: - "Scent Mob Cap" - SRParasitesSystems.cfg
===<u>General</u>===
*Living Weapons will now evolve into Sentient weapons by killing mobs
*Living/Sentient Lance will now apply Needler on hit
*Increased maximum phase number to 10
*Parasites will not drop xp if the phase is too high
*Parasites will only spawn naturally if the phase is too high
*Parasites will always spawn as a variant if the phase is too high
===<u>Mobs</u>===
*Changed Texture for [[Feral Human]]
*Changed Texture for [[Feral Sheep]]
*Small parasites (width <= 1 or height <= 1) will no longer spawn Beckons
*Changed running animation for Feral Human
*Changed running animation for [[Feral Villager]]
*Reduced melee cooldown for all Feral versions by ~1/3
*Added particle effects to all crude versions, same particles as feral versions
*Increased Scent spawning cooldown for the [[Heed]] from 20 to 50 seconds
*Gnat stats rebalanced: - Health changed: 17 -> 5 - Armor changed: 10 -> 2 - No longer drops XP upon player kill
